units.title: round_money changes its rounding mode for every caller, flag on or off
units.where: Stop 4 (the flag-off branch) and stop 6 (the receipt job).

code.diff:
def round_money(amount)
-  amount.round(TAX_PRECISION)
+  amount.round(2, half: :even)
 end

def perform(cart_id)
   cart = Cart.find(cart_id)
   calculator = Checkout::TotalsCalculator.new(cart)
   ReceiptMailer.receipt(cart, calculator.round_money(cart.subtotal)).deliver_later
 end

proof.evidence: Request path: `CheckoutControllerTest` (unchanged) executes it with the flag off. Job path: `ReceiptJob` has no life cycle test. One isolated test asserts 1.235 rounds to 1.24, which is true under both modes.

exposure.evidence: called on the flag-off branch of `compute_totals` (line 15) and from `ReceiptJob#perform` (line 5); neither checks the flag

undo.evidence: reverting the deploy restores the old rounding

why_level: Floor rule 3: an entry point above it, `ReceiptJob#perform`, has no life cycle test.
Critical: it is on a money path, and no test changed in this diff observes the new rounding.

would_change.text: Add a job test for `ReceiptJob`, and one request assertion that tells the two rounding modes apart.
Also branch on `:per_line_tax_rounding` at `round_money:35`, keeping the old line as the flag-off path.

gaps: no metric or log on the totals path

questions.text: Is half-even rounding meant to apply to existing totals, or only to per-line tax?
questions.why: No description came with the change, and this line is outside the flag.
questions.changes: If only per-line tax, the second suggestion applies.

units.title: The new flag check runs on every checkout and loads the shop
units.what: `compute_totals` now starts with `Features.enabled?(:per_line_tax_rounding, @cart.shop)`. The old body is the flag-off branch, unchanged apart from indentation.

code.diff:
def compute_totals
+  if Features.enabled?(:per_line_tax_rounding, @cart.shop)
+    per_line_totals
+  else
     subtotal = @cart.subtotal
     tax = tax_for(subtotal)
     { subtotal: round_money(subtotal), tax: round_money(tax), total: round_money(subtotal + tax) }
+  end
 end

proof.evidence: `CheckoutControllerTest`: the existing test (unchanged) executes the flag-off branch; the added test executes the flag-on branch with the flag on

exposure.value: the check: everyone; the new branch: nobody yet
exposure.evidence: the flag-off branch is the removed code, re-indented

undo.evidence: turning the flag off takes the old branch

why_level: Raised to mid: the check itself runs for everyone. It passes `@cart.shop`, so every checkout loads the shop before branching, and `Features.enabled?` calls `Store.fetch` with no rescue.

would_change.text: Pass an already-loaded value to the check, and confirm the flag store fails closed.

gaps: nothing on either branch is tagged with the flag state, so the two groups cannot be compared during ramp

questions.text: What does `Features.enabled?` do when the flag store is unreachable?
questions.changes: If it raises, every checkout fails during a flag-store outage and this unit is high.
